title: Verify that after making changes to the reconciliation File Generator configuration, the file is generated at the configured destination path based on the updated configuration.
preconditions:
1)User must login with valid credentials.
2)Application connectivity must be there with connection type(SCP, FTP & File system).
3)Recon should run successfully.
4)Recon file generator configuration must be done.

steps.action: go to System setting->Recon file generator.
steps.expectedResult: Recon file generator list page should display.
Recon file generator Master page should display.

steps.action: add the field through fields dropdown and click on save button.
After recon run successfully go to configured the destination path
Open & verify file  having correct data .
